subject: Where the factory side jack pad sits and how to support it, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Lift and support the car".

mustShow.text: HERO: A small rectangular plastic pad along the lower side of the body near a wheel; a hollow rectangle that is the lift and stand point. Do NOT depict its fine detail: keep it a plain generic shape.

mustNotShow: side jack pad rectangle detail (Exact distance from the wheel arch; the pad's notch or arrow markings and the front-centre jack point geometry are not established)
